entries.zh: 盂钵，钵盂；盛饮食之器（用以给人饮食的器皿）
entries.en: bowl or small jar (orca/jarilla) for giving something to eat or drink; alms bowl
entries.notes: 西语词头 Orca/〃uár 拼写含混，孟 疑为 盂 之形近字，据 盂钵 与『予人以饮食之器』的释义推定

entries.zh: 针眼，麦粒肿；俗称狗占（狗针）
entries.en: stye on the eye (orzuelo); native term lit. 'dog-needle'

entries.zh: 眼睛生狗占：目中长出针眼（麦粒肿）
entries.en: a stye has grown on the eye
entries.notes: 汉字栏 瞷/睭 存疑，词义据词头 orzuelo 与目部例句推定

entries.zh: 针眼，麦粒肿〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged original; gloss uncertain] stye on the eye
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存 目占（疑脱一字），闽南语栏 lu bag chiâm iôs 与之对不上，仅西语词头可读

entries.zh: 接连，连续；成列之物按序计数（一连）
entries.en: in succession, one after another; numeral for things in order
to arrange, to put in order
rank, grade; order of degrees and dignity

entries.zh: 次第，等第之序；亦指序文
entries.en: order, sequence; rank or degree; preface

entries.zh: 行，行列（文字之行）；字母之序
entries.en: row or line of letters; alphabetical order

entries.zh: 义，正义〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 闽南语栏 T99 污损难辨，汉字栏 義/羙 存疑，仅西语词头 orden de justicia 可读

entries.zh: 次序；按数目而列之次第〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged headword; gloss uncertain] order; order by number
entries.notes: 西语词头中段划除难辨，闽南语例句除首字 次 音外难以通读

entries.zh: 同僚，侪辈；同一会中之人（修会会士互称）
entries.en: fellows, colleagues of the same order; used of religious brethren
entries.notes: 词头夹注拉丁式 ut…de religiosi，且 僚 字与闽南语栏读音的对应靠上下文推定

entries.zh: 吾侪，我等同僚（修会中人自称其侪辈）
entries.en: my fellows, my colleagues (as religious speak of their order)
entries.notes: 词头夹注西语 como el Religioso，释义承上条 僚 字推定

entries.en: to receive and respond; order and correspondence
order, sequence of things (as by number)
order, succession; one thing after another
order, sequence; ranking one after another
entries.notes: 汉字栏 苐/带 存疑，闽南语栏首字音与两候选字读音皆不合，字面难定而词义承前后条推定
